name: Lagoon, Open Water
desc1: The smooth surface of the water reflects sunlight in all directions.
desc2: Being only fifteen feet deep here, you can see almost to the bottom.
desc3: Occasionally a large dark shape passes by, sending the smaller fish
desc4: speeding away. The reef is visible at times, about ten feet down, and
desc5: the vibrant colours of the coral are breathtaking.
